title: t3cp/mrs/2
description: data/v1/mrs.json: the fork author's pull requests and issues on upstream T3 Code, read from the public GitHub search API at site build time (two queries, type:pr and type:issue). Also checked by the build, beyond this schema: counts add up to items plus omitted, each item's kind and state is counted, items are sorted by updated_at descending (then number descending), item numbers are unique, a pull request has a /pull/ url, is open, merged or closed and has closed_as null, an issue has an /issues/ url, is open or closed and has closed_as only when closed, source_queries is the pull request query alone (a list kept from t3cp/mrs/1, issues not read) or it and the issue query of the same author, fetched_at null only on a stale file with no items, and the file is at most 32768 bytes.

fetched_at.description: When the list was read from GitHub (UTC, whole seconds). Kept from the previous file when a build could not read GitHub; null only if no build has read it yet.

stale.description: true when the latest build could not read GitHub and kept the previous list.

source_queries.description: The search queries the list comes from: the pull request query, then the issue query.

counts.description: Every item the queries returned, by kind and state, including any left out of items.

omitted.description: How many of the oldest items were left out of items to keep the file within 32 KB.

closed_as.description: A closed issue's reason as GitHub gives it (completed: fixed; not_planned: closed); null for a pull request, an open issue, and a closed issue with no such reason.
